metabolic_screening.label: Newborn Metabolic Screening (blood spot / PKU)
metabolic_screening.program: Maryland Department of Health — Division of Newborn & Childhood Screening
metabolic_screening.state_form_note: MD has a standalone 'NBS Refusal Form' (Updated, fillable PDF). Covers over 60 conditions per the federal RUSP. Religious exemption available. The form requires parent acknowledgment of risks and a signed release holding harmless the MD Department of Health. NBS Follow-Up Unit must be notified within 12 hours of refusal.
metabolic_screening.kit_ordering_note: NBS supplies ordered through MD DH; specimens shipped to Maryland State Newborn Screening Laboratory.
metabolic_screening.specimen_tracking_note: NBS tracking via MD State Newborn Screening Laboratory; midwives verify specimen receipt.
metabolic_screening.midwife_role: Complete MD NBS TRF 12–48h after birth, give refusal form to parents if declining, send specimen+TRF to MD lab. Notify NBS Follow-Up Unit within 12 hours of refusal.
metabolic_screening.declination_law: MD statute; COMAR 10.52.15 — religious exemption available; refusal form required for declination.

billing.note: Parents are billed directly; most insurance covers screening; midwife is NOT billed for the screening test itself.

hearing_screening.label: Newborn Hearing Screening
hearing_screening.state_form_note: Hearing screening refusal uses the same NBS Refusal Form. MD mandates hearing screening; refusal documented on the form.
hearing_screening.midwife_role: Educate parents; if opted-in, refer to EHDI-approved audiologist; if declined, document refusal on form.

cchd_screening.label: CCHD Pulse Oximetry Screening (critical congenital heart disease)
cchd_screening.state_form_note: CCHD screening refusal uses the same NBS Refusal Form. COMAR 10.52.15.03 requires pre-test information and the right to refuse CCHD screening. The refusal must be documented in writing with parent signature.
cchd_screening.midwife_role: Perform or refer for pulse-ox screening; document refusal on form if declined.

erythromycin_eye_ointment.label: Erythromycin Eye Ointment (newborn eye prophylaxis)
erythromycin_eye_ointment.state_form_note: Eye prophylaxis is a standard of care; no standalone state declination form — practice standard is a signed informed-refusal/waiver document (app master form).
erythromycin_eye_ointment.midwife_role: If opted-in: administer erythromycin within 2h of birth. If declined: signed informed refusal (in-app master form) retained in records.

vitamin_k.label: Vitamin K (oral or injection)
vitamin_k.midwife_role: Three-way informed choice (oral / shot / none) documented in-app; shot administered by midwife or referred.

hepatitis_b_vaccine.label: Hepatitis B Vaccine (birth dose)
hepatitis_b_vaccine.midwife_role: Birth-dose consent or declination documented in writing; administered dose reported to MD MIIS.

gestational_diabetes.label: Gestational Diabetes Screening (prenatal)
gestational_diabetes.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice; midwife refers out for glucose testing when declined.

group_b_strep.label: Group B Strep Screening & Prophylaxis (prenatal)
group_b_strep.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice per ACOG/CDC; swab testing via referral or in-office; intrapartum antibiotics referred if opted-in.
